result.topic_en: Riemann introduces the notation and the name 'Ableitung' (after Lagrange's fonctions dérivées) for the generalized derivative of arbitrary order ν, defining it as the coefficient of h^ν in a series expansion of z(x+h) in powers of h whose exponents differ by integers, multiplied by a factor K_ν depending only on ν.
